# A residual asked for on a USD account in a CAD transaction. Refused: the
# residual is a transaction-currency figure, and writing it as an amount in
# another currency would invent a 1:1 rate.
2026-03-01 * "Sell 100 USD with a residual in the wrong currency"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "-135.00"
	Assets:Bank 139.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "139.00"
	Assets:Bank:USD $residual$ USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
